It is an expression that details the condition or state of a ‘لعاف’ (Doer), ‘هب لوعفم’ (Object), a ‘ادتبم’ (subject) or
a ‘رورمج’ (Genitive case noun, often preceded by a preposition or in a possessive construction, a ‘هيلإ فاضم’).
The one whose condition is being detailed is called ‘لالحا وذ’ (Possessor of state)
Here are 2 examples, one where the ‘لالحا وذ’ is a ‘لعاف’ and one where it’s a ‘هب لوعفم’.
I helped Zaid whilst he was tied up.
Here is a an example where the ‘لالحا وذ’ is a ‘ادتبم’.

.’لاح‘ is the ’اسلاج‘ and ’لعافلا مسا‘ the ’مئنا‘ inside of ’لصتم عوفرم يرمض‘ which is the ’وه‘ ’لعاف‘ is the ’لالحا وذ‘
The ‘لاح’ has preceded the ‘لالحا وذ’. It is permissible for the ‘لالحا وذ’ to precede the ‘لاح’.
In 3a, the ‘لالحا وذ’ is the ‘ديز‘ ’ادتبم’ and the ‘لاح’ is ‘اسلاج’ which is immediately after the ‘لالحا وذ’.

Here are a few examples where the ‘لالحا وذ’ is a ‘رورمج’.
This is Zaid’s walk whilst (he is) injured.
I passed Zaid whilst (he was) laughing.
In 4b, the ‘لالحا وذ’ is the ‘ديز‘ ’هيلإ فاضم’ and ‘احورمج’ is the ‘لاح’. The ‘لاح’ and the ‘لالحا وذ’ are combined and
labelled ‘هيلإ فاضم’. There are some specific rules for this scenario, i.e. when the ‘لالحا وذ’ is a ‘هيلإ فاضم’,
which we will return to very soon Insha’Allah.
In 4a, the ‘لالحا وذ’ is the ‘ديز‘ ’رورمج’ which is preceded by a ‘راج’, a preposition. ‘اكحاض’ is the ‘لاح’ which is
immediately after the ‘لالحا وذ’. The ‘لاح’ and the ‘لالحا وذ’ are combined and labelled ‘رورمج’.

As for the ‘لاح’, it can come in the form of:
The ‘لالحا وذ’ or the ‘لاح’ will not manifest in any other way.
If the ‘لالحا’ is an ‘مسا’, then it will either be a ‘قتشم’, a ‘ردصم’ or a ‘دماج’.
.’ليضفتلا مسا‘ and ’ةغلابلما مسا‘ ,’ةهبشلما ةفصلا‘ ,’لوعفلما مسا‘ ,’لعافلا مسا‘
I ate the food whilst (it was) hot.
When the ‘لالحا’ is a ‘قتشم’, it will correspond with the ‘لالحا وذ’ in number and gender.
The ‘قتشم’ form is the primary form for ‘لالحا’. All other forms of ‘لالحا’ are related to the ‘قتشم’.
The term ‘ردصم’ includes all types of ‘ردصم’.
Whether ‘درمج’ or ‘هيف ديزم’, they’re all included.
I opened the door whilst creaking.
When the ‘لالحا’ is a ‘ردصم’, it will NOT correspond with the ‘لالحا وذ’ in number or gender.
.does not have a particular gender and nor does it have a single, dual or plural form ’ردصم‘
Therefore, ‘ردصم’ can be used, with the same form, in any context and it will express the ‘قتشم’ meaning.
In 6a, ‘اًّرَص’ is in the meaning of ‘اًّراص’ and in 6b, ‘اًمايق’ is in the meaning of ‘ْمئاق’.
The term ‘دماج’ includes names and spontaneous nouns which are not derived.
There are many ways the ‘دماج’ noun can be ‘لالحا’. I shall elaborate on a few.
When the ‘دماج’ is used for resemblance. The ‘دماج’ will be interpreted into a ‘قتشم’
I donated wealth whilst I was (generous like) Hatim
Zaid ran whilst he was (a coward like) a rabbit.
When the ‘لالحا’ is a ‘دماج’ is a proper noun a name, it will NOT correspond with the ‘لالحا وذ’ in number or
gender. Despite the ‘دماج’ name having gender qualities and number forms, they’re not considered here.
This is because it is not the ‘دماج’ name that is intended, rather the interpretation of the ‘دماج’ is intended.
In 7a, ‘اًِتِاَح’ is interpreted as ‘ةغلابلما مسا‘ ’اًدا وَج’ and in 7b, ‘اًبنرأ’ is interpreted as ‘ َةهبشلما ةفصلا‘ ’ناَبَج’.

As mentioned before, a لعفis a word which denotes an action while it’s meaning contains one of the 3
Whilst considering the tenses, لعفis categorised into 3 categories:
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a meaning whilst being connected to the past tense.
Here, the word رَصَنis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the past tense.
Therefore رَصَنmeans “To help in the past”.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a meaning whilst being connected to the present or future tense.
The context will clarify which of the 2 tenses is implied.
Here, the word َُرُصْنَ يis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the present or
future tense. Therefore َُرُصْنَ يmeans “To help in the present or future”.
The context will be considered in order to specify a tense.
If the action of help is currently underway then the present tense will be specified.
If the action is understood to be conducted in the future then the future tense will be specified.
Or if َُرُصْنَ يwas preceded by َْنِإ, then the future tense will be specified.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a command which is connected to the future tense.
Commands are only able to be complied to in the future, hence no other tense is implied.
Here, the word َْرُصْنُأis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the future tense
in the imperative mood. Therefore َْرُصْنُأmeans “You must help in the future”.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a prohibitive command which is connected to the future tense.
Commands are only able to be complied to in the future, hence no other tense is implied here also.
Here, the word ََْرُصْنَ تَ َلis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the future tense
in the prohibitive mood. Therefore ََْرُصْنَ تَ َلmeans “You must NOT help in the future”.
Considering the transcending ability of a verb, لعفis categorised into 2 categories:
This is a لعفwhich is capable of taking a direct Object (receiver of action).
It’s able to transcend the Subject and apply it’s self directly to the Object.
This is a لعفwhich is not capable of taking a direct Object (receiver of action).
It is only able to apply it’s self to the Subject directly but not to the Object.
In order for the مزلََلعفto apply it’s meaning to the Object, it will require a فرح(particle) which will
enable the مزلََلعفto take an Object indirectly.

Whilst considering the tenses, لعفis categorised into 3 categories:
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a meaning whilst being connected to the past tense.
Here, the word رَصَنis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the past tense.
Therefore رَصَنmeans “To help in the past”.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a meaning whilst being connected to the present or future tense.
The context will clarify which of the 2 tenses is implied.
Here, the word َُرُصْنَ يis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the present or
future tense. Therefore َُرُصْنَ يmeans “To help in the present or future”.
The context will be considered in order to specify a tense.
If the action of help is currently underway then the present tense will be specified.
If the action is understood to be conducted in the future then the future tense will be specified.
Or if َُرُصْنَ يwas preceded by َْنِإ, then the future tense will be specified.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a command which is connected to the future tense.
Commands are only able to be complied to in the future, hence no other tense is implied.
Here, the word َْرُصْنُأis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the future tense
in the imperative mood. Therefore َْرُصْنُأmeans “You must help in the future”.
This is a لعفwhich signifies upon a prohibitive command which is connected to the future tense.
Commands are only able to be complied to in the future, hence no other tense is implied here also.
Here, the word ََْرُصْنَ تَ َلis signifying upon the meaning “to help” whilst being connected to the future tense
in the prohibitive mood. Therefore ََْرُصْنَ تَ َلmeans “You must NOT help in the future”.
